3-1(tsha): rgya gar skad du/shI pad+ma ma he shwa ra du+ha rak+Shi ta ni rA kr-i taM gu
3-2(tsha): Na tar+t+ha nA ma/bod skad du/dpala pad+ma dbang chen dregs pa srung bzlag yon
3-3(tsha): tan gyi rgyad ces bya ba/lhun gyis grub pa'i sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor chen po

3-5(tsha): gcig na/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung

4-15(tsha): bzhi rnams ni 'di lta ste/theg chen dgu dang ldan pa'i phyir na mgo dgu
